fields.meaning: Car speed computed each tick from the velocity vector; doc 54's live check saw 69-324 km/h and every speed gate uses this value.
Vehicle yaw; the tick derives the heading vector (-sin, -cos) from it.
AI driver/session mode: 0 race, 1 recovery stop, 2 stopped/handed over, 3 pit approach, 4/5 pit-garage wait, 6 reverse, 7 stop. Modes 4/5 park the car (throttle 0, brake 1, steer 0).
Vehicle condition status; value 2 = retired/pit mode. While 2 the game keeps re-retiring the car (limbo), so it must be cleared to recover the car.
Current gear from the auto-shift logic; 0 while shifting, -1 is the neutral/reverse sentinel.
Highest available gear; an upshift is ordered only while the current gear is below this.
Shift lockout timer; while greater than zero the auto-shift logic returns immediately.
Live car world position X used by the locator, steering law and watchdog; the path walk refreshes it and brainlog.py reads it.
Live car world position Y used by the locator, steering law and watchdog.
Live car world position Z used by the locator, steering law and watchdog.
Placement pose X written from the racing-line path node by the path walk. Object kind is OPEN; this is a placement/visual walk, not per-tick driving (REVIEW_4).
Placement pose Y written from the racing-line path node by the path walk (not per-tick driving; REVIEW_4).
Placement pose Z written from the racing-line path node by the path walk (not per-tick driving; REVIEW_4).
Velocity X; the tick computes the speed field as the length of the velocity vector.
Velocity Y (see velocity_x).
Velocity Z (see velocity_x).
Pointer to the current racing-line waypoint; the locator re-finds it when the car is far away, and the whole AI tick is skipped when it is null.
19 look-ahead waypoint pointers; entries follow the next link, or the alternate branch link when the branch id matches the branch-override field.
Measured lateral position in the current waypoint frame; doc 54's live check saw -3.78..+2.70 m.
1 when the car is inside the current waypoint width plus a 1.5 m margin.
Per-slot opponent vehicle pointer (first field of the 68-byte slot record, count 5). Cleared each scan, then the five nearest vehicles are inserted.
Per-slot squared distance to the opponent (distance field in each slot record); the 999999 sentinel means empty.
Per-team-record match flag (record stride 28); 1 when the record matched this car/team.
Team id stored in the team record (+4 in the 28-byte record).
Per-team-record threshold float (+12 in the record), reset to 500 by the team-scan reset flag.
First lateral corridor bound; AISteering clamps the published lateral target between the two bounds. Widening them live let a dead AI car steer off the racing line.
Second lateral corridor bound (see corridor_bound_1).
Multiplier of the tire-force term in the per-waypoint corner-speed limit.
Offset added to the tire-force term in the per-waypoint corner-speed limit.
Overall scale of the per-waypoint corner-speed limit.
AIAbility dynamic pace multiplier walked by +-0.01 per tick and reset by car-condition/pit paths; external writes do not persist.
20-slot projected-speed profile from the braking look-ahead; each slot is the projected speed at a waypoint ahead.
Pointer to the waypoint that forces braking now, or null when the projection reaches zero first.
Target speed of the limiting waypoint; the 9999.0 sentinel means none.
Per-segment deceleration factor used when projecting speed loss from braking.
Lateral offset request; zeroed every tick unless the yield target is set or the car is in condition 2. With override-enable it replaces the published target.
Working lateral target before the published-target overrides; seeded from the request and clamped to the corridor.
Non-zero means publish the lateral request directly as the steering target.
Forced lateral offset that wins over both the working target and the request when non-zero.
Final lateral offset the steering law follows (live-confirmed); set from the working target, then overridden by the request or the forced value.
Look-ahead waypoint index 0..3 chosen from speed; the steering law aims at the waypoint pointer this many entries ahead. Conflict noted in ABI_README (organic pit trace names it a pit-phase enum).
Anchor point X recorded at the last waypoint change; the steering law adds the distance driven since the change along the waypoint direction.
Anchor point Z recorded at the last waypoint change (see steering_anchor_x).
Steering-lock divisor; steer = heading error / this. Live constant 0.4014 rad (about 23 degrees). Writers still OPEN.
Per-opponent overtaking mode in the 5-slot table (1/2/3/4/7/8/16; 7/8/16 are attempt states).
Per-opponent working state compared with the per-opponent reset value. Same address is the team record's -9999 sentinel field written by the traffic scan.
Throttle candidate before post-processing (steer lift, traction control, speed limit).
Brake candidate before post-processing.
Normalized steering command written by the steering law; live recomputation from the law correlated 0.989.
Throttle actuator copy written at tick end from the throttle candidate (0 in park mode).
Steering actuator copy written at tick end from the steer command; live-equal to the command in every sample (0 in park mode).
Brake actuator copy written at tick end from the brake candidate (1 in park mode).
Speed governor input (pit limiter etc.); reset to 1000000.0 every tick before the AI functions, so a write must land between the reset and the pedal post-processor.
Throttle smoothing constant used at race start when the race-start byte is set.
Difficulty throttle cap = AIDifficultyScalar * 0.75, applied when the interaction target is set.
Wrong-way/stuck counter; +5 per tick while travel direction opposes yaw, -1 otherwise. Above the limit the mode switches to recovery.
Counter threshold that triggers the mode-1 recovery stop.
Saved position X used by the 4-second progress check.
Saved position Y used by the 4-second progress check.

Progress-check timer; when stuck it toggles the mode between normal and reverse attempt.

derived_views.formula: waypoint = look-ahead entry current_waypoint_ptr + steering_lookahead_index; target = waypoint.position + published_lateral_target * waypoint.right + distance_since_waypoint_change * waypoint.direction
corner_speed = (tire_force_solver(waypoint) * corner_speed_force_coeff + corner_speed_force_offset) * corner_speed_scale * ai_pace_multiplier * waypoint.grip_factor
braking while the look-ahead's limiting_waypoint_ptr target (braking_target_speed) sits below the projected speed; then cmd_brake ramps +0.2/tick and cmd_throttle = 0
true_lateral = dot(car_position - waypoint_position, waypoint.perpendicular); published_lateral_target is the AI's intended offset, not its true lateral position
